heading: Authority of Director of Office of Management and Budget not affected
lead: This division does not limit the authorities and responsibilities of the Director of the Office of Management and Budget in effect on December 1, 1983.

notes.text: Historical and Revision Notes RevisedSectionSource (U.S. Code)Source (Statutes at Large) 230541:405(h)(2).Pub. L. 93–400, § 6(h)(2), Aug. 30, 1974, 88 Stat. 797; Pub. L. 96–83, § 4, Oct. 10, 1979, 93 Stat. 649; Pub. L. 98–191, § 5, Dec. 1, 1983, 97 Stat. 1328. The words “in effect on December 1, 1983” are substituted for “current” for clarity.
